FOREWORD

0.

0.1 This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 15 June 1979, after the draft finalized by the Laboratory Glassware and Related Apparatus Sectional Committee had been approved by the Chemical Division Council. 0.2 This standard was first published in 1963. However, in view of the increasing importance assigned to the use of uniform terminology both at the national and international levels in the field of thermometry of liquid-in-glass thermometers, the Committee involving the use responsible for the preparation of the standard felt the necessity of this Some of the terms relating to the glxs portion of thermorevision. Accordingly, refer-<xncc rnay have meters are covered in IS : 138`2-1961*. to be made to it in some casrs. 0.3 In this revision several new terms have been incorpor:lted and attempt has also been made to- up-date the defillitiolls with a view to with those used by the International aligning them, as far as possible, Organization for Standardization (ISO), 1Yorld I2leteol-ol(~gical Orgsnization ( LVMO ), International Organization of Lrgal h~ctrolog! ( O!ML ) and World Health Organization ( WHO ). However, wh(`nevtr any differences occur between the definitions given in this standard anti those the definitiorjs siven in tile latter shall given in a material specification. prevail fl;r the purpose of that standard.
